text: To clean, heat, or cool some object, check countertops, stoveburners, and diningtables before opening cabinets.
To put some object in or on a cabinet, shelf, drawer, or countertop, check desks, sidetables, and countertops first.
To put some object in or on a cabinet, safe, or drawer, go to that container, open it, then move.
To clean some object, hold it, go to sinkbasin 1, clean with sinkbasin 1, then move away.
To heat some object or put a hot object away, hold it, go to microwave 1, run heat with microwave 1.
To cool some object or put a cool object away, hold it, go to fridge 1, run cool with fridge 1.
To examine or look at an item with a desklamp, go to desks, dressers, shelves, and sidetables to take it.
To examine or look at an item with a desklamp, hold the item, go to desklamp table, and use desklamp.
To find two items and put them in a cabinet, shelf, or desk, place item one before taking item two.
To find two items and put them in a cabinet, shelf, or desk, search other surfaces after placing item one.
Whenever putting an item into a closed fridge, microwave, safe, or cabinet, open that receptacle before moving the item.
To clean, heat, or cool some object, open and inspect cabinets 1 through 12 in order before taking any object.
To put some object in or on a cabinet, shelf, or drawer, open every drawer and cabinet in order first.
To cool some object or put a cool object away, wash it at sinkbasin 1 first and leave inside fridge 1.
To heat some object or put a hot object away, chill it in fridge 1 first and leave inside microwave 1.
To clean some object and put it away, move it into sinkbasin 1 first and toggle faucet 1 repeatedly.
To find two items and put them in a cabinet, shelf, or desk, take both items into inventory before placing.
To examine or look at an item with a desklamp, leave the item on its shelf and toggle lamps first.
